_meta.title: Session 33c — Opus 4.8 System Card completeness pass: Multimodal (8.12) + Multi-Agent (8.11) + OSS-Fuzz (3.3.4)
_meta.context: Completeness re-pass of the Claude Opus 4.8 System Card sections skipped in the Session 33 first pass. (1) Multimodal 8.12: ChartMuseum (arxiv 2505.13444), LAB-Bench FigQA, CharXiv Reasoning (re-graded) — all with no-tools + Python-tools splits. (2) Multi-Agent 8.11: BrowseComp orchestrator-with-blocking-subagents reaches 88.5 (vs single-agent 84.3). (3) Cyber 3.3.4 OSS-Fuzz: Opus 4.8 made any progress (>0) on 38.5% of ~830 entry-points/228 projects vs Mythos 76.7%, neither Opus reached a 1.0 working exploit (Mythos hit 1.0 on 12 targets). ChartQAPro/ScreenSpot-Pro/OSWorld-Verified already ingested in Session 33.
_meta.rule: STRICT-ATTRIBUTION. All values verbatim from System Card Figures 8.12.1.A/8.12.2.A/8.12.3.A/8.12.4.A + Section 8.11.1 + page 53. charxiv_reasoning_no_tools/_tools already exist in DB — only Opus 4.8 added (existing comparison rows untouched). chartmuseum/lab_bench_figqa split into _no_tools/_tools NEW IDs with full Claude-family comparison. benchmarks.name: OSS-Fuzz — Any-Progress Rate (score>0)
benchmarks.description: Claude Opus 4.8 System Card OSS-Fuzz eval (Section 3.3.4): ~830 fuzzing entry-points from 228 open-source projects, model turns a found bug into an exploit primitive (grades 0.2 mem-safety crash → 1.0 control-flow hijack). % of targets reaching any non-zero grade, no safeguards. Neither Opus reached 1.0; Mythos hit 1.0 on 12 targets.

scores._section: === CharXiv Reasoning (re-graded) — Opus 4.8 added to existing _no_tools/_tools IDs ===
scores._note: Figure 8.12.4.A, new grader (thinking trace removed). Opus 4.7 81.3, Sonnet 4.6 71.6, Mythos 86.2 in card.
Python tools. Opus 4.7 90.1 (4.8 marginally below), Sonnet 4.6 85.3, Mythos 92.5.
Orchestrator-with-blocking-subagents harness — highest BrowseComp config (single-agent 84.3, 5-agent team 85.4). Multi-agent productively absorbs extra token budget.
Any-progress (score>0) on 38.5% of targets (failed >0 on 61.5%). Reached 0.6 only once, no 1.0. With safeguards: max 0.4, 4.9% rate (vs 18.1% without). Roughly equivalent to Opus 4.7.
Failed on only 23.3% of targets. Scored 1.0 on 12 targets, 0.8 on 4, 0.6 on 7, 0.4 on 28.3%, 0.2 on 45.6%. Far ahead of both Opus 4.x.
